question: In which year did India qualify for the FIFA World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India qualified for the 1950 FIFA World Cup, which was held in Brazil.
 
• This was the first and only time India qualified for the FIFA World Cup.
 
• India's qualification came after several teams withdrew from the tournament.
 
• Despite qualifying, India did not participate in the 1950 World Cup.
 
• One of the reasons cited for not participating was the lack of proper football boots for the players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIFA World Cup:**

 
 
• The FIFA World Cup is an international football competition contested by the senior men's national teams of the members of FIFA.
 
• It is held every four years and is one of the most widely viewed sporting events worldwide.
 
• The first World Cup was held in 1930, hosted by Uruguay.
 
 
 
• **India's Football History:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in football, with the sport being popular in various regions such as West Bengal, Kerala, and Goa.
 
• The All India Football Federation (AIFF) is the governing body for football in India, established in 1937.
 
 
 
• **Reasons for Withdrawal:**
 
 
• There were multiple reasons cited for India's withdrawal from the 1950 World Cup, including travel costs, team preparation, and the insistence on playing barefoot.
 
• These factors led to India's absence from the tournament despite qualifying.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football Achievements:**
 
 
• India has won the AFC Asian Cup in 1964 and has been a significant force in the South Asian region.
 
• The country has produced notable footballers like Baichung Bhutia and Sunil Chhetri.
